content: Passkey recovery risk is real and unresolved industry-wide in 2026: synced passkeys (platform cloud keychains) mitigate single-device loss, device-bound passkeys (security keys, some Windows Hello) do not sync and create hard lockout risk. Recommended mitigations: register a second passkey on another device, keep a printed/offline recovery code, keep a spare hardware key, verified backup email/recovery contact. Vendors are starting to surface 'recovery health' status at enrollment time.
